items.title: Genie 4 world model opens to developers in the Gemini API and Google AI Studio
items.summary: Google's first world model for developers is now callable through the Gemini API and AI Studio, so builders can create interactive generated-world experiences. Pricing appeared only in replies and is unverified.

reception.summary: Mostly jokes and feature requests; a few ask about cost per minute of generated world and one reply claims about $363 an hour, unverified. Nobody reports building with it yet.

items.title: ManiLadder: 112 simulated manipulation tasks in 4 calibrated difficulty levels, with code and checkpoints
items.summary: A simulation benchmark for robot manipulation that sets difficulty from a reference policy's success rate. A flow-matching policy, pi0.5 and a coding agent all fall from roughly 70% on Level 1 to under 10% on Level 4; real-robot reruns of 8 tasks kept the same difficulty order.

items.title: Firecrawl Local: open-source Rust scrape primitive for running Firecrawl on your own machine
items.summary: Firecrawl rebuilt its repo so agents can scrape locally, claiming a scrape primitive 37x faster and 230x lighter (11 MB idle) than the old self-hosted build, with the same MCP server and SDKs.

reception.summary: Replies are short enthusiasm and 'how do I use this' questions, plus bot replies; no one reports benchmarking the speed or memory claims.

items.title: Airbnb serves a tuned Gemma 4 E2B for policy classification at 35 ms median latency on one RTX Pro 6000
items.summary: Per Google's Gemma account, Airbnb's benchmark lifted max F1 from 0.563 to 0.902 with the small open model, matching frontier APIs at about 1% of the spend and 35 ms median latency versus about 900 ms.

items.title: Kling 4.0 generates native 4K video on fal, with optional 10-bit HDR
items.summary: fal exposes Kling 4.0 text, image, reference and video-edit modes at native 4K, with 10-bit HDR output at 4K and 1080p.

items.title: Ideogram 4.6 available on fal with instruction-based edits of existing images
items.summary: fal added Ideogram 4.6 for text-to-image and image editing, including targeted edits to product details, clothing colors and poster typography. Ideogram separately said open weights are planned for 4.6; none are released yet.

items.title: PostTrainBench adds Qwen 4 Max and charts the US vs Chinese model gap at about 8 points
items.summary: PostTrainBench now lists Qwen 4 Max at roughly GLM-5.3 Flash level (36.7 vs 36.8 percent), and a follow-up chart tracks the gap between US and Chinese models on research-automation capabilities.

items.title: NVIDIA GR00T 2 shown driving real dexterous hands end to end, uncut at 1x
items.summary: A single uninterrupted clip claims GR00T 2 controls real dexterous hands autonomously. No weights, paper or numbers in the post.

reception.summary: Repliers praise the uncut 1x format and ask about failure recovery and error rates; nobody reports reproducing it.

items.title: RoboColosseum compares five robot models folding a towel zero-shot on a bimanual YAM arm
items.summary: Side-by-side clips of five models on the same zero-shot task, with the caveat that timings are not comparable. Academic labs can apply for free eval hours.

items.title: Olala mini: 7B total, 1B active model mixing Mamba-3 with grouped differential attention, trained on 13T tokens
items.summary: An author's thread describes a small hybrid model with architecture changes over the Transformer. No weights link was seen.

items.title: Tencent Hy4-Flash quantized to 4.84 bpw EXL3 (92.9 GiB) to fit one DGX Spark, with 96.92% top-1 agreement
items.summary: A community quantization of the 220B-parameter, 12B-active Hy4-Flash reports 0.0288 mean KL divergence and 96.92% top-1 agreement with the original, sized for a single DGX Spark. Self-reported; no repo link in the post.
